home/evan/b/y1

-- script --
start /home/evan
size 50 8
note leaving a folder and coming back finds the cursor where it was
press enter
press down down
state current x3
press left
state dir /home/evan
state current a
press down
state current b
press up
press right
state current x3
press left
press right
state current x3
note going up lands on the folder just left
press left
press left
state dir /home
state current evan
